query.description: Search term (required, 1-100 characters)
Search type (required): members, projects, domains, or links
Results limit (optional, default: 5, max: 10 for members/projects/domains, max: 20 for links)

request.description:
Unified search across workspace members, projects, domains, and links. Different search strategies used based on entity type:

SIMPLE ENTITIES (members, projects, domains):
- Uses case-insensitive ILIKE pattern matching
- Multi-word terms split into separate ILIKE conditions with AND logic
- Max 10 results

Search fields:
- members: user.name
- projects: projects.projectTitle
- domains: domains.domainUrl

LINKS (optimized for higher volume):
- Uses PostgreSQL Full-Text Search (FTS) with to_tsvector/to_tsquery
- Prefix matching support with :* operator
- Multi-word terms joined with & (AND) operator
- Results ordered by ts_rank (relevance score)
- Max 20 results
- Requires GIN index on linkTitle tsvector

Search field:
- links: links.linkTitle

Examples:
- ?q=john&type=members (finds users with 'john' in name)
- ?q=mobile app&type=projects (finds projects with both 'mobile' AND 'app' in title)
- ?q=example.com&type=domains (finds domains with 'example.com' in URL)
- ?q=bug fix&type=links (finds links with both 'bug' AND 'fix' in title, ranked by relevance)

Response data: { message, data: { results } }

item.name: Domain Verification
item.description: Public domain verification endpoint. Used by recorder script to verify domain ownership. No authentication required - uses token-based verification.

header.description: Origin header from the domain being verified (required)

request.description:
Verify domain ownership using a JWT token embedded in the recorder script. This is a public endpoint with CORS enabled (origin: *, methods: POST).

The recorder script includes this token and makes a POST request from the domain to be verified. The Origin header is automatically set by the browser and must match the domain being verified.

Validations:
- Origin header is required and must be valid
- Token must be valid JWT with domain information
- Domain hostname must match the Origin header

Response data: DomainVerificationData (domainStatus: 'verified', workspaceId, domainId, domainUrl)

item.name: Links
item.description: Link management endpoints. Links are shareable URLs for capturing user recordings.

query.description: Page number (default: 1)
Items per page, 1-20 (default: 10)
Filter by workspace member ID(s) - comma-separated for multiple: member1,member2,member3
Filter by project ID
Filter by domain ID(s) - comma-separated for multiple: domain1,domain2,domain3
Filter by provider type(s) - comma-separated for multiple: linear,jira,github (valid: linear, notion, jira, github, shortcut, asana, clickup, height, plane)
NOT DOCUMENTED - Reserved for future use. Only 'recording' is currently supported
Sort field: created_at, link_title
Sort direction: asc, desc

request.description:
Get paginated links for a workspace with optional filters and sorting.

Filters support comma-separated values for multiple selections:
- created_by: Filter by multiple workspace members (e.g., ?created_by=member1,member2)
- domain_id: Filter by multiple domains (e.g., ?domain_id=dom1,dom2)
- link_provider_type: Filter by multiple provider types (e.g., ?link_provider_type=github,linear,jira)

Multiple filters combine with AND logic (must match all specified filters).
Within each filter, values combine with OR logic (match any of the specified values).

Response data: LinksListData (workspaceId, links, pagination)

Get detailed information for a specific link by ID.

Response data: LinkByIdData (workspaceId, link)

Create a new link. 

Body:
- domainId (required): Domain ID for the recording
- projectId (optional): Project ID. If not provided, uses workspace's default project
- linkReference (optional): URL or title to parse for provider info. If not provided, uses "{firstName}'s Recording Link"
- linkReusable (optional): Whether link can be used multiple times. Default: false

The linkReference field is parsed to extract provider information (e.g., Linear, Jira, GitHub, etc.). Supported providers: linear, notion, jira, github, shortcut, asana, clickup, height, plane.

Response data: LinkCreateData (workspaceId, link)

Update a link. At least one field must be provided.

Body (all optional):
- linkTitle: Title for the link (max 255 chars)
- linkReusable: Whether link can be reused
- linkProviderType: Provider type (linear, notion, jira, etc.)
- linkProviderId: Provider-specific ID
- linkProviderRef: Provider-specific reference

Response data: LinkUpdateData (workspaceId, link)

Soft delete a link.

Response data: { workspaceId, linkId }

item.name: Session (Upload)
item.description:
Recording session and upload endpoints. Public endpoints using token-based authentication (no cookie auth required).

Workflow:
1. GET /session - Initialize session with link_id, receive session_token
2. POST /session - Initialize upload with session_token, receive upload_token and presigned URLs
3. Upload files directly to presigned URLs
4. PATCH /session - Complete or mark upload as partial/failed

Token Lifetimes:
- Session Token: 180 minutes
- Upload Token: 120 minutes
- Presigned URLs: 90 minutes

query.description: JWT token from the link URL (obtained from the recording link)

request.description:
Initialize a recording session using a JWT link token. Returns a session token with embedded workspace preferences.

Validations:
- Token must be a valid JWT link token
- Link must exist and not be deleted
- Link type must be 'recording'
- If link is not reusable, no existing recordings allowed

Response Headers:
- X-Session-Token-Expires-In: Token lifetime in seconds
- X-Session-Token-Expires-At: Token expiry timestamp (ISO 8601)

Response data: SessionInitData (sessionToken, expiresIn)

Initialize upload and receive presigned URLs for file uploads.

Validations:
- Session token must be valid and not expired
- Link must still exist and not be deleted
- Recording duration must be within workspace limit
- Video and thumbnail files are required
- Console/network logs only if workspace preferences allow
- File sizes must be within limits (500MB video, 10MB thumbnail, 50MB logs)

File Types:
- video: Required. Allowed: video/webm, video/mp4, video/x-matroska, video/ogg
- thumbnail: Required. Allowed: image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp
- console_log: Optional (if rccl enabled). Allowed: application/x-ndjson, application/ndjson
- network_log: Optional (if rcsl enabled). Allowed: application/json

Metadata (required):
- systemMetadata (required): System information captured during recording
  - date: Recording date (string)
  - time: Recording time (string)
  - browser: Browser info (string)
  - os: Operating system info (string)
  - windowSize: Browser window dimensions (object with width and height)
- customMetadata (optional): Arbitrary key-value pairs for client-specific data

Response Headers:
- X-Upload-Token-Expires-In: Upload token lifetime in seconds
- X-Upload-Token-Expires-At: Upload token expiry timestamp (ISO 8601)
- X-Presigned-Url-Expires-In: Presigned URL lifetime in seconds

Response data: UploadInitData (recordingId, uploadToken, presignedUrls)

Mark upload as complete after all files uploaded successfully.

Validations:
- Upload token must be valid and not expired
- Recording ID must match token's recording ID
- Recording must be in 'pending' or 'partial' state
- All expected files must exist in storage with correct sizes

Body fields:
- recording_id (required): ID of the recording
- state (required): Must be 'complete'

Response Headers:
- X-Upload-Token-Remaining: Seconds remaining on upload token

Response data: UploadCompleteData (success, recordingId, status: 'available')

Mark upload as partial when video uploaded but some secondary files failed.

Use case: Video and thumbnail uploaded, but optional files (console_log or network_log) failed. The recording will still be accessible with the files that were successfully uploaded.

Validations:
- Upload token must be valid and not expired
- Recording ID must match token's recording ID
- Recording must be in 'pending' or 'partial' state
- Required files (video, thumbnail) must be successfully uploaded
- The service verifies files in storage before setting status

Body fields:
- recording_id (required): ID of the recording
- state (required): Must be 'partial'

Response Headers:
- X-Upload-Token-Remaining: Seconds remaining on upload token

Response data: UploadCompleteData (success, recordingId, status: 'partial')

Mark upload as failed when video upload fails or user cancels.

Use case: Critical files (video or thumbnail) failed to upload, making the recording unusable.

Validations:
- Upload token must be valid and not expired
- Recording ID must match token's recording ID
- Recording must be in 'pending' or 'partial' state

Body fields:
- recording_id (required): ID of the recording
- state (required): Must be 'failed'

Response Headers:
- X-Upload-Token-Remaining: Seconds remaining on upload token

Response data: UploadCompleteData (success, recordingId, status: 'failed')
